name: Fleadh Cheoil weekend
desc: Musicians from three counties are in town. Live nights pull a crowd and everyone's in great form.

name: All-Ireland hurling final
desc: The county's in the final. With a big screen the place will be packed to the door.

name: St Patrick's Day
desc: Bunting, shamrock and the whole town out. The busiest day of the year.

name: Harvest fair
desc: Farmers in from the mart with money in their pockets. They stay for one more.
